notes: The first GitHub Pages push for this release was built from .pages-build/site (the Cloudflare export, whose asset URLs are root-relative). GitHub Pages serves the project site under /knowledge-garden-site, so every script 404'd and the page stayed on the loading splash; commit bcb08983 republished from .github-pages-build/site, which prefixes the base path, and the page renders v1.0.238.

The mobile defect was a naming collision in globals.css: `.breadcrumb span, .breadcrumb svg` at <=720px also hid the house icon and label inside the back-home link, leaving an empty 18x44 bordered box. The fix keeps the icon and hides only the label.
The retired yellow letter tile had no separate asset: it was a text node inside .brand-symbol, so nothing else had to be deleted.
